# awscc_transfer_host_key (Resource)

Resource type definition for AWS::Transfer::HostKey



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) The identifier of the server that contains the host key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The text description for this host key.
- `host_key_body` (String) The private key portion of an SSH key pair. Transfer Family accepts RSA, ECDSA, and ED25519 keys.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Key-value pairs that can be used to group and search for host keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The unique Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the host key.
- `date_imported` (String) The date on which the host key was added to the server.
- `host_key_fingerprint` (String) The public key fingerprint, which is a short sequence of bytes used to identify the longer public key.
- `host_key_id` (String) A unique identifier for the host key.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `type` (String) The encryption algorithm that is used for the host key.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The name assigned to the tag that you create.
- `value` (String) Contains one or more values that you assigned to the key name you create.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_transfer_host_key.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The unique Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the host key

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_transfer_host_key.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_transfer_host_key.example "arn"
```
